features.justification: The supplied SHCS chart gives .281 clearance and .438 counterbore diameter for nominal 1/4-inch hardware (D008). Its .250 ordinary-head counterbore depth must not be applied to this LOW HEAD callout, particularly in a .250-thick plate. Rear-face entry is established by the hidden larger circles in the front view and the right-view hidden steps. The .438 diameter is a chart-based proposal requiring verification against the selected low-head hardware; no recess depth is invented.

features.rationale: Repeat the rear counterbore at all four mounting positions once the seed counterbore depth is resolved.
